battery: dumpsys battery unplug; dumpsys battery set status 3; dumpsys battery set level 48; dumpsys battery set present 1; dumpsys battery set ac 0; dumpsys battery set usb 0; dumpsys battery set wireless 0; dumpsys battery set dock 0; echo BATTERY_STEALTH_OK
drift: dumpsys battery set level 44; echo BATTERY_DRIFT_OK
browser: printf '%s' '--webrtc-ip-handling-policy=default_public_interface_only' > /data/local/tmp/webview-command-line; chmod 644 /data/local/tmp/webview-command-line; setprop webviewcommandline '--webrtc-ip-handling-policy=default_public_interface_only'; settings put global webrtc_ip_handling_policy default_public_interface_only; settings put global private_dns_mode hostname; settings put global private_dns dns.alidns.com; echo BROWSER_ARGS_OK args=--webrtc-ip-handling-policy=default_public_interface_only dns=dns.alidns.com
